description: The figure is a dual-metric bar chart illustrating average performance (accuracy) and average generation length (token count) for four methods labeled CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, shown as two separated bar groups within the same plot. The horizontal axis is categorical and visually divided into two clusters: a left cluster under the title “Accuracy (%)” and a right cluster under the title “Token Count,” with each cluster containing four bars corresponding to the same four methods; the individual category names are not printed on the x-axis and instead are conveyed via the color legend at the bottom (CoT in red, CoD in orange, CCoT in light blue, CoUT in green). The left vertical axis (for the left cluster) is labeled implicitly by the title “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100 with evenly spaced tick marks at 5-unit intervals (70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100). The right vertical axis (for the right cluster) corresponds to “Token Count,” uses a linear scale from 0 to 800, and shows regularly spaced tick labels at 100-token intervals. In the accuracy cluster, the red CoT bar is labeled 91.19, the orange CoD bar is labeled 80.89, the light-blue CCoT bar is labeled 88.50, and the green CoUT bar is labeled 88.40, with values printed above each bar. In the token-count cluster, the red CoT bar is labeled 676.85, the orange CoD bar is labeled 534.24, the light-blue CCoT bar is labeled 445.91, and the green CoUT bar is labeled 354.46, again with numeric labels above the bars. The bars are displayed as single, unstacked bars in each cluster (no grouping within a category beyond the two metric clusters), they do not appear to be sorted by value, and there is no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or callouts beyond the numeric annotations.
